comment:
* An object responsible for allocation of buffers. This is an extension point to enable buffer
 * pooling within an application.

methods.name: public static BufferAllocator unpooled()
methods.comment: Returns an unpooled buffer allocator, which will create a new buffer for each request.

methods.name: public abstract AllocatedBuffer allocateHeapBuffer(int capacity)
methods.comment: Allocates a buffer with the given capacity that is backed by an array on the heap.

methods.name: public abstract AllocatedBuffer allocateDirectBuffer(int capacity)
methods.comment: Allocates a direct (i.e. non-heap) buffer with the given capacity.
